message.content:
The image is a vertical magazine cover with the masthead "TEMPO" in large white letters across the top. Below the masthead, smaller text reads "EDISI 23 - 29 Juli 2001". Above the masthead, a blue banner displays the white text "Wawancara Khusus Jenderal Bimantoro".

An editorial illustration occupies the central space. It depicts two caricatured figures, a man and a woman, pulling at opposite ends of a large, dark brown ornate chair with red upholstery. The man on the left wears a green suit and a black songkok hat. He leans forward, gripping the chair’s base, with a wide-open mouth showing teeth and clenched fists. The woman on the right wears a bright red suit and glasses. She pulls the top of the chair toward her, her body angled away. Two smaller male figures in suits watch from behind a low horizontal barrier in the background.

To the left, yellow text reads "Satu Republik, Dua Presiden?". At the bottom right, the price "Rp 10.800" is printed. A barcode with numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00021" is at the bottom left, next to the text "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". The background features blue radiating lines and a stylized building structure.
